source.name: ECDC – European Respiratory Virus Surveillance Summary (ERVISS)
source.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC), an EU agency
source.note: Figures are reported every week by the national public health institutes (FHI, Folkhälsomyndigheten and SSI) to ECDC, which publishes them openly every Friday. Recent weeks can be revised.

findings: Norway: 171 lab-confirmed influenza cases in week 42 (+8% on the week before). Intensity: baseline (5% of an average season peak).
Sweden: 81 lab-confirmed influenza cases in week 42 (+62% on the week before). Intensity: baseline (3% of an average season peak).
Denmark: 87 lab-confirmed influenza cases in week 42 (+18% on the week before). Intensity: baseline (4% of an average season peak).
Denmark is above ECDC's epidemic threshold: 12.2% of sentinel samples were positive for influenza in week 42.
Highest influenza level: Norway, at 5% of an average season peak.
Dominant influenza virus so far this season (subtyped samples, all three countries): A(H1N1)pdm09 (84%).
COVID-19, lab-confirmed cases this week: Norway 167 (+8%, low); Sweden 85 (−30%, baseline); Denmark 56 (−5%, baseline).
RSV, lab-confirmed cases this week: Norway 4 (−33%, baseline); Sweden 1 (−67%, baseline); Denmark 0 (–, baseline).
Hospital and severity this week: Sweden 2 deaths with influenza; Sweden 6 deaths with COVID-19.
headline: Influenza: 339 lab-confirmed cases in the Nordics this week, up 20% on last week – baseline intensity (5% of an average season peak).
Denmark is above ECDC's epidemic threshold.
Nordics: COVID-19 308 cases (stable, baseline intensity); RSV 5 cases (down 44%, baseline intensity).
